results.name: Explicit branch, department and unit routes resolve exact canonical descendant populations
Invalid organizational locations fail closed and never broaden to whole organization
Partial whole-organization access offers explicit accessible subtrees without silently slicing aggregates
A descendant denial prevents broader cohorts and global contextual sources despite a root allow
A union of branch grants is not exact-root authority for global records
Bank-wide assurance remains broader context when a local department is selected
Multi-target supplier programs include only targets relevant to the selected local cohort
Branch-only KRI collection is not reported as missing department or unit responses
Report and source links preserve organization, period, KRI cycle, loss basis and currency
The canonical organizational selector updates stale URL context instead of being undone by render
Loss filter transitions make the inherited scope and resolved defaults portable in the URL
Saved loss views restore exact scope, explicit dates, currency and grouping after navigation changes
Saved response views retain the respondent and review-state filters
Saved views recheck access and hierarchy before changing navigation state
Report CSV exports include portable scope, currency, date and cycle metadata
Current permissions guard raw data, selected-event exports and printing after a rendered view
New captured reports remain byte-stable and older packs gain no live scope annex
Captured contextual boundaries and current child denies govern pack access independently of navigation scope
Read-only reporting grants cannot create, edit or publish a draft and the builder exposes no editable fields
Legacy draft inputs are stopped in capture phase after author access is revoked
Report authors require a separate submission grant and publishing preserves the captured source
Report-only observers cannot create operational follow-up actions
Report controls and all perspectives render actual registered routes without invalid data
Invalid loss filters remain editable error views and unsupported period/cycle URLs fail closed
